title: Jelly world
description: A port of TypeGPU's Jelly Slider, after Voicu Apostol's design. The jelly is ray-marched from a distance field, so it bends and wobbles as you drag it. Stretch it, squash it, pull the lever, or just give it a few seconds. The resolution adapts to hold the frame rate, and TAA keeps the picture smooth.
line: A ray-marched jelly slider to squish and stretch. Give it a few seconds.
hint: drag the jelly to stretch or squash it
